description: Given name from the employee's full name.
Family name from the employee's full name.
Date the employee completes the form.
Employee's street address.
City of the employee's residence.
State of the employee's residence.
Postal code of the employee's residence.

text: Date of Injury. Fecha de la lesión (accidente).
description: Date when the injury or accident occurred.

text: Time of Injury. Hora en que ocurrió.
description: Time of day when the injury occurred.

text: Address and description of where injury happened. Dirección/lugar dónde occurió el accidente.
description: Location and brief description of the place where the injury happened.

text: Describe injury and part of body affected. Describa la lesión y parte del cuerpo afectada.
description: Detailed description of the injury and body parts affected.

text: Social Security Number. Número de Seguro Social del Empleado.
description: Employee's SSN.

text: Check if you agree to receive notices about your claim by email only. Marque si usted acepta recibir notificaciones sobre su reclamo solo por correo electrónico.
description: Employee consent to receive claim notices exclusively by email.

text: Employee’s e-mail. Correo electrónico del empleado.
description: Email address to receive electronic notices if consent given.

text: Name of employer. Nombre del empleador.
description: Legal name of the employer.
Employer's address.

text: Date employer first knew of injury. Fecha en que el empleador supo por primera vez de la lesión o accidente.
description: Date employer first became aware of the injury.

text: Date claim form was provided to employee. Fecha en que se le entregó al empleado la petición.
description: Date the employer provided the claim form to the employee.

text: Date employer received claim form. Fecha en que el empleado devolvió la petición al empleador.
description: Date the employer received the completed claim form from the employee.

text: Name and address of insurance carrier or adjusting agency. Nombre y dirección de la compañía de seguros o agencia administradora de seguros.
description: Insurance carrier or adjusting agency name and address.

text: Insurance Policy Number. El número de la póliza de Seguro.
description: Policy number for the employer's insurance.
Job title of the employer representative.
Telephone number of the employer or representative.
Checkbox indicating distribution of employer copy.
Checkbox indicating distribution of employee copy.
Checkbox indicating distribution of claims administrator copy.
Checkbox indicating distribution of temporary receipt to the employee.
